settings.title: Settings
settings.startupDescription: Lyrico loads lightweight song summaries from SQLite. Audio files are scanned only when you add or explicitly rescan a folder.
settings.persistenceValue: Loading the active SQLite database path...
settings.artworkValue: Prefetched near the viewport and loaded in shared batches
settings.enabledPluginsHint: {{count}} enabled plugins are searched together by default.
settings.onlyTranslationHint: Do not save original lyrics when a translation is available.

artistSplit.title: Artist splitting
artistSplit.artistSeparatorHint: Used to join multiple ARTIST values while scanning tags. Rescan folders after changing it.
artistSplit.enabledHint: List songs with multiple artists under each artist separately.
artistSplit.builtinSeparatorsHint: Choose the separators used in artist names.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsHint: Type a separator and press Enter. Whitespace is preserved when it is part of the separator.
artistSplit.customSeparatorsPlaceholder: Add separators such as + or with
artistSplit.noSplitHint: Checked names are protected even when they contain an enabled separator.
artistSplit.customNoSplitHint: Type a complete artist name and press Enter.
artistSplit.customNoSplitPlaceholder: Add artist names that must stay intact
